Import an Apple Health export file. In the Health app on your iPhone choose
your profile picture, then "Export All Health Data", and pass the resulting file here.

The file is streamed, so even multi-gigabyte exports use little memory.
Importing the same file again adds nothing new.

Usage:
  healthcli import apple <export.zip|export.xml> [flags]

Examples:
  healthcli import apple export.zip
  healthcli import apple export.xml --json

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for apple

Global Flags:
      --db string   SQLite database path (default: per-user data dir)
      --json        output JSON instead of human-readable text
